Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:10:1.hebrew: ומאי מגו - איכא למימר הכא, דקאמר: השתא דאמרת מגו, אמרינן מגו? וחרש אמאי קני? הא לא זכי פקח לנפשיה דנימא דזכי נמי לחבריה, ולא הויא הגבהה דפקח הגבהה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:10:1.english: And what [is the] miggo - [that] can be said here, that [the Gemara] says: "Now that you have said miggo, we say miggo"? And why does the deaf-mute acquire [it]? Behold, the mentally competent person did not acquire [it] for himself, such that we could say that he also acquires [it] for his fellow, and [thus] the lifting of the mentally competent person is not a [valid] lifting.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:11:1.hebrew: אם תמצא לומר - כלומר, אפילו אם תמצא לומר המגביה מציאה לחבירו כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:11:1.english: If you say - That is to say, even if you say [that] one who lifts a found item on behalf of another, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:11:2.english: Here, he lifts it with the intention [of acquiring it] for himself - [This refers to] this mentally competent person.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:13:1.english: So that they will not come to quarrel - With those who snatch [it] from them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:14:1.english: From where - From which clause of our Mishnah does he infer [this] to say, "This implies"?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:14:2.hebrew: הא קאמר כולה שלי ואנא אגבהתיה - והיאך נאמר לא יקנה לא זה ולא זה, ויבא אחר ויטלנה? והלא כל אחד טוען "אני הגבהתיה", ואין כאן מגביה מציאה לחבירו! ומה יש לו להשיב? בשלמא האי שכנגדו, המוחזק בה כמוהו, אמר "לא הגבהת אתה, כי אם אני", אבל אחר מן השוק מה יטעון?:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:14:2.english: Behold, he says, "All of it is mine, and I lifted it" - And how can we say [that] neither this one nor that one acquires [it], and another [person] may come and take it? For does not each one claim, "I lifted it," and there is no [case] here of one who lifts a found object for his fellow! And what does he [an outsider] have to answer? Granted, this [litigant] opposite him, who is holding it just like him, says, "You did not lift [it], rather I [did]"; but another [person] from the marketplace, what can he claim?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:15:1.hebrew: ממשנה יתירה - אמרינן דהמגביה מציאה כו', ומשום הכי אמרינן יחלוקו, דאמרינן שניהם הגביהוה, והוה ליה כל אחד מגביה מציאה לו ולחבירו, וקני. דאי משום דלא ידעינן הי מינייהו משקר, והוה ליה ממון המוטל בספק, וחולקין בשבועה משום שלא יהא כל אחד ואחד הולך ותוקף, כדאמרי' לעיל (בבא מציעא דף ג.) — הא שמענא ליה מרישא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:15:1.english: From a superfluous mishna - We say that one who lifts a found item, etc., and for this reason we say they shall divide [it], for we say [that] both of them lifted it, so each one is [in the position of] one who lifts a found item for himself and for his fellow, and [his fellow] acquires [his share]. For if [it were only] because we do not know which of them is lying, and it is money whose ownership is in doubt, and they divide [it] with an oath so that each and every one does not go and seize [it], as we said above (Bava Metzia 3a) — we already learned that from the first clause.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:19:1.english: That I will be like one returning a lost item - Since he could have said, "All of it is mine," and [instead] he said, "Half of it is mine."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:19:2.english: And he should be exempt - From an oath.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:20:1.english: From a superfluous Mishnah, etc. - As I explained.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:21:1.hebrew: דרכוב קני - ואע"ג דלא משיכה היא, שאינה זזה ממקומה, שאין מנהיגה ברגליו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:21:1.english: That one who rides acquires - Even though it is not [an act of] pulling, since [the animal] does not move from its place, as he is not driving it with his legs.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:22:1.hebrew: צריכא למימר - דהיכא דלקוחה בין שניהם, שיחלקוה בלא שבועה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:22:1.english: [Does it] need to be said - that where it was purchased between the two of them, they divide it without an oath?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:22:2.hebrew: אלא לאו במציאה - ואיצטריך לאשמועינן שאין אחר יכול לחוטפה, דמגביה מציאה לחבירו קנה חבירו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:22:2.english: Rather, is it not [referring] to a found item - And it was necessary to teach us that another [person] cannot snatch it, because one who lifts a found item for his fellow, his fellow acquires [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:23:1.hebrew: ורבא אמר לך - בעלמא, היכא דלא נתכוין המגביה לזכות בה, לא קנה חבירו. ומשנה יתירה דמתני' אשמועינן, המגביה מציאה לו ולחבירו — קנה אף חבירו, דמגו דזכי לנפשיה זכי נמי לחבריה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:23:1.english: And Rava said to you - In general, where the one who lifts [it] did not intend to acquire it [for himself], his fellow does not acquire [it]. And the superfluous [clause of the] Mishnah teaches us [that when] one lifts a found object for himself and for his fellow, his fellow also acquires [it], because since he acquires [it] for himself, he also acquires [it] for his fellow.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:2:1.english: As it is fit for the children of kings - For young children.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:4:1.hebrew: זאת אומרת - מתני' דקתני שנים שהגביהו מציאה קנאוה ויחלוקו, וכשמגביה, מגביה לדעת שיקנה בה חבירו חציה, ש"מ המגביה מציאה כו'. ולקמיה פריך: דיוקא דרמי בר חמא מהיכא — מאיזו בבא ממשנתנו הוא למד כן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:4:1.english: That is to say - [From] the Mishnah, which teaches [that] two [people] who lifted a found item acquired it and shall divide [it]; and when [each] lifts [it], he lifts [it] with the intention that his fellow shall acquire half of it thereby — learn from this [that] one who lifts a found item, etc. And later [the Gemara] asks: From where is Rami bar Ḥama's inference — from which clause of our Mishnah does he learn this?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:5:1.english: And neither this [one] nor that [one] acquires [it] - And anyone who wishes may snatch it from their hands.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:6:1.hebrew: לעולם אימא לך לא קנה חבירו - היכא דמגביה לא נתכוין לקנות בה כלום, וטעמא אמר לקמן (בבא מציעא דף י.) דהוי תופס לבעל חוב במקום כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:6:1.english: Actually, I could say to you [that] the other [person] does not acquire [it] - Where the one who lifts [it] did not intend to acquire any [part] of it, and the reason is stated later (Bava Metzia 10a), that he is [like] one who seizes [property] for a creditor in a place [where it harms others], etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:6:2.hebrew: והכא - דקתני במתניתין שנים שהגביהו מציאה קנו, מגו דזכי לנפשיה, זכי נמי לחבריה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:6:2.english: And here - where it teaches in the Mishnah [that] two [people] who lifted a found item acquired [it], since he acquires for himself, he also acquires for his fellow.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:7:1.hebrew: תדע - דאפילו אמר לא קנה חבירו היכא דהגביה כולה לדעת חבירו, הכא דהגביה לעצמו ולחבירו, קני משום מגו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:7:1.english: Know - That even [if one] said "his fellow does not acquire" where he lifted all of it on behalf of his fellow, here, where he lifted [it] for himself and for his fellow, he [the fellow] acquires [his share] because of miggo.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:7:2.hebrew: פטור - המשלח פטור מלשלם כפל, דקי"ל אין שליח לדבר עבירה להתחייב שולחו, אלא שליח, דדברי הרב ודברי התלמיד — דברי מי שומעין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:7:2.english: Exempt - The sender is exempt from paying double [payment], for we hold [that] there is no agency for a transgression for his sender to become liable, rather [it is] the agent [who is liable], for [when there are] the words of the Master and the words of the student, whose words should one heed?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:7:3.hebrew: ואילו שותפין שגנבו - והאחד הוציאה מרשות בעלים לדעתו ולדעת חבירו, אמרינן בבבא קמא (דף עח:) דחייבין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:7:3.english: Whereas partners who stole - and one [of them] removed it from the owner's domain on his own behalf and on his fellow's behalf, we say in Bava Kamma (78b) that they are liable.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:8:1.hebrew: השתא דאמרת מגו - דזכי לנפשיה כו'. חרש ופקח שהגביהו מציאה, קנאוה. אע"פ שהגבהה של חרש אינה הגבהה לקנות אלא מפני דרכי שלום, כדתנן (גיטין דף נט:): חרש שוטה וקטן יש בהן גזל מפני דרכי שלום — אפילו הכי אמר: מגו דזכי לנפשיה כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:8:1.english: Now that you said miggo - [meaning] that since [he] acquires for himself, etc. [In a case of] a deaf-mute and a mentally competent person who lifted a found item, they have acquired it. Even though the lifting of a deaf-mute is not a [valid] lifting to acquire [by Torah law], [it is] only because of the ways of peace, as we learned in a Mishnah (Gittin 59b): "A deaf-mute, an imbecile, and a minor are subject to [the prohibition of] robbery because of the ways of peace" — even so, [Rava] said: Since [he] acquires for himself, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:9:1.hebrew: בשלמא חרש קני דקא מגבה לה בן דעת - לראשה השני לצורך שניהם, וראשו של צד חרש לגבי חרש מיהא הויא הגבהה, כדתקון ליה מפני דרכי שלום. אלא פקח במאי קני? לגבי פקח הוי ראשה שהגביה החרש כמונח על גבי קרקע, דהגבהה דחרש לא קניא אלא מדרכי שלום בעלמא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 8a:9:1.english: Granted, a deaf-mute acquires, as a mentally competent person lifts it - [He lifts] its other end for the benefit of both of them, and the end on the deaf-mute's side is, at least with respect to the deaf-mute, [valid] lifting, as [the Sages] instituted for him because of the ways of peace. But how does the mentally competent person acquire [his share]? With respect to the mentally competent person, the end that the deaf-mute lifted is like [something] resting upon the ground, for a deaf-mute's lifting does not effect acquisition except merely on account of the ways of peace.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8a:10:1.hebrew: ומאי מגו מגו דשני חרשין - תימה, מנלן? דלמא תרי מגו לא אמרי', דב' חרשין דקנו היינו מטעם מגו דזכי לנפשיה זכי נמי לחבריה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8a:10:1.english: "And what is miggo? Since [miggo] two deaf-mutes..." - This is astonishing: from where [do we know this]? Perhaps we do not say two miggos [i.e., a miggo upon a miggo], for [the reason] that two deaf-mutes acquire is itself because of miggo: since he acquires for himself, he also acquires for his fellow.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8a:17:1.hebrew: אלא מסיפא זה אומר כולה שלי וזה אומר חציה שלי - אית דל"ג הכא "הא תו למה לי", דממשנה גופה קא דייק: דקאמר "חציה שלי", והיינו שהגביה עם חבירו, ולפי דבריו לא יטול כלום — אלא ודאי מגביה מציאה לחבירו זכה. ופריך: "ממאי דבמציאה? דלמא במקח וממכר!". והוא הדין דהוה מצי למדחי, דהא דאמר "חציה שלי" — כגון דאמר "תפסתיה חציה בידי" או "הגבהתיה כולה לקנות חציה", אבל עדיין היה מדקדק מיתורא דמתני'; לכך דחי ליה, דאפי' מיתורא אינו יכול לדקדק. ולספרים דגרסי "הא תו למה לי", י"ל דמשום דמגופא דמתני' לא מצי למידק כדפרישית. אך קשה: אמאי קאמר "דלמא במקח וממכר"? אפילו מיירי במציאה מצי לדחויי כדדחי! וי"ל בדוחק: "ממאי דבמציאה" — דלהכי לא מוקמת במקח וממכר משום דלא משכחת חידוש אלא במגביה מציאה לחבירו? כי נמי איירי במקח וממכר יש חידוש, דלא נימא "משיב אבידה הוא"; וה"ה אם מיירי במציאה לא יוכל להוכיח כלום:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8a:17:1.english: "Rather, from the latter clause: This one says all of it is mine and that one says half of it is mine" - There are [texts] that do not read "Why do I need this as well?" here, for [Rami bar Ḥama] infers [his ruling] from the Mishnah itself: since he says "Half of it is mine," which is where he lifted it together with his fellow, and according to his own statement he should not take anything — rather, certainly, one who lifts a found item on behalf of his fellow, [his fellow] acquires [it]. And [the Gemara] asks: "From where [is it inferred] that [this clause] refers to a found item? Perhaps [it refers] to buying and selling!" [The Gemara] could equally have rejected [his inference by saying] that when he says "Half of it is mine," it is a case where he says "I grasped half of it in my hand" or "I lifted all of it to acquire half of it"; however, he would still be inferring [his ruling] from the superfluity of the Mishnah. Therefore, [the Gemara] rejects his [inference by arguing] that even from the superfluity he cannot infer [anything]. And according to the texts that read "Why do I need this as well?", one can say that [it is] because one cannot infer [it] from the body of the Mishnah itself, as I explained. However, it is difficult: why does [the Gemara] say "Perhaps [it refers] to buying and selling"? Even if it deals with a found item, one could reject [the inference] as [just] rejected [above]! One can answer with difficulty: "From where [do you know] that [it refers] to a found item?" — [meaning,] is it for this reason that you do not establish it as [referring to] buying and selling, because you do not find any novel ruling except in [the case of] one who lifts a found item on behalf of his fellow? Even if it deals with buying and selling there is a novel ruling, so that we should not say "he is [like] one returning a lost item"; and the same applies if it deals with a found item — he will not be able to prove anything [from it].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8a:1:1.hebrew: דחזיא לקטנים - ופריך דטלית מוזהבת לא עבדי לקטנים. ול"ג "דחזיא לתרוייהו", דא"כ מאי פריך מטלית מוזהבת:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8a:1:1.english: As it is fit for small [children] - And [the Gemara] asks [this] because they do not make a gilded garment for small [children]. And we do not read [the variant text] "as it is fit for both of them," for if so, what does [the Gemara] ask from a gilded garment?

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8a:7:1.hebrew: ושותפין שגנבו - פי' בקונטרס שהוציא לדעתו ולדעת חבירו, כדאיתא בב"ק (דף עח:). ואין נראה, דהתם בטביחה איירי, וטביחה — אפי' אמר "צא וטבח לי" חייב, דדרשינן (שם דף עא.) "תחת" לרבות השליח; אלא שותפין שגנבו — שהגביהו שניהם:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 8a:7:1.english: And partners who stole - The Kuntres [Rashi] explained that [one partner] took [the animal] out on his own behalf and on his partner's behalf, as is stated in Bava Kamma (78b). But this does not appear [correct], for there it is speaking of slaughter, and [regarding] slaughter, even if one said [to his agent], "Go out and slaughter for me," [the sender] is liable, since we expound (ibid., 71a) "tachat" to include the agent; rather, "partners who stole" [refers to a case] where both of them lifted [it].
